title: Intelligence contacts tell Kurt his analysis is about 80% right

tellings.quote: raise your hand if someone from somewhere like DoD or D uh was it did someone from one of three layer agencies can maybe met you somewhere and go hey I just want to tell you like you're about 80% right your analysis

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on the show, says people from the Pentagon or one of the "three letter agencies" have approached him to say, "you're about 80% right" about his analysis of hidden power. He tells it as his own experience and asks the others in the room to raise a hand if the same has happened to them. If true, insiders would be quietly confirming much of what outsiders guess.
